BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to charitable organizations; amending RCW19.09.076, 19.09.520, and 19.09.530; adding new sections to chapter19.09 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 24.03 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A charitable organization that is exemptunder RCW 19.09.076(1)(a) must register with the secretary in a form tobe prescribed by the secretary if the charitable organization raisesmore than one thousand dollars in charitable solicitations in anyaccounting year and engages in solicitations from the general publicmore than once in any accounting year. The form must include the name,address, and telephone number of the charitable organization; astatement that the charitable organization meets the requirements forthe exemption under RCW 19.09.076(1)(a); and other information asdetermined by the secretary. The form must be signed and dated by thepresident, treasurer, or other officer of the charitable organization.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.09.076 and 2007 c 471 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The application requirements of RCW 19.09.075 do not apply to: p. 1 HB 2047 (a) Any charitable organization raising less than an amount as setby rule adopted by the secretary in any accounting year when all theactivities of the organization, including all fund raising activities,are carried on by persons who are unpaid for their services and no partof the charitable organization's assets or income inures to the benefitof or is paid to any officer or member of the organization. Acharitable organization exempt under this subsection must comply withthe registration requirements in section 1 of this act; (b) Political organizations; or (c) Appeals for funds on behalf of a specific individual named inthe solicitation, but only if all of the proceeds of the solicitationare given to or expended for the direct benefit of that individual. (2) All entities soliciting contributions for charitable purposesshall comply with the requirements of RCW 19.09.100.

The secretary shall refer to the attorneygeneral for enforcement any case involving a charitable organizationthat: (1) Files the registration required under section 1 of this actwhen the charitable organization does not meet the requirements for theexemption under RCW 19.09.076(1)(a); (2) Is required to file the registration required under section 1of this act and the charitable organization, after notification fromthe secretary, fails to file the registration within fortyfive daysfollowing the issuance of the notice; or (3) Fails to comply with the requirements of section 4 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 24.03 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A corporation organized under this chapter that is a charitableorganization as defined in RCW 19.09.020 must register as a charitableorganization in accordance with chapter 19.09 RCW within fortyfivedays of the issuance of a certificate of incorporation by the secretaryof state. At the time the certificate of incorporation is issued, thesecretary of state shall notify the corporation of the requirementimposed by this section.

A governmental entity may not contract withor provide grants to a charitable organization or an organization thatholds itself out as a charitable organization unless the governmentalentity has determined that the organization is in compliance with theregistration requirements of chapter 19.09 RCW. For the purposes ofthis section, "governmental entity" means any agency, department, ordivision of the state, or a county, city, town, municipal corporation,quasimunicipal corporation, school district, special purpose district,or other political subdivision of the state.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.09.520 and 2007 c 471 s 13 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) To provide for a charitable organization education program asauthorized in RCW 19.09.510, the secretary ((may establish)) shallcharge an additional fee((s)) of ten dollars on original registrationsand annual renewals for entities filing with the secretary asorganizations pursuant to this chapter. (2) The fee((s)) authorized in this section ((are)) is in additionto the ((existing)) fees established under section 8 of this act andother fees established by the secretary in rule for organizationsrequired to register under this chapter.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.09.530 and 2007 c 471 s 14 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The charitable organization education account is created in(([the])) the custody of the state ((treasury)) treasurer. Allreceipts from the fee((s)) authorized in RCW 19.09.520(1) must bedeposited into the account. ((Moneys in the account may be spent onlyafter appropriation.)) Expenditures from the account may be used onlyfor the charitable organization education program authorized in RCW19.09.510. Only the secretary may authorize expenditures from theaccount. The account is subject to allotment procedures under chapter43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is not required for expenditures.

The secretary of state shall charge andcollect: (1) For an original registration of a charitable organization, afee of fifty dollars for the first year of registration; and p. 3 HB 2047 (2) For an annual renewal of a charitable organizationregistration, a renewal fee of forty dollars.
Sections 1, 3, 5, and 8 of this act are eachadded to chapter 19.09 RCW.
